description: Unlinked brand mentions: searches the free SERP backend for `brand` as a QUERY, then checks whether each result page already links to `trackedDomain`. Free: one SERP fetch plus up to 10 live third-party page fetches, no AI-gateway spend. ALWAYS narrow on `state` first: `serp_unavailable` means no free SERP provider could be reached — never treat it as "zero mentions found". `analysed` carries `candidates[]`, each `status: "linked" | "unlinked" | "unreachable"`. Bounded by SERP result count (the first page or two of free-SERP results), never an exhaustive web crawl or a full content index — the Common Crawl-based version of this gap is a decided wont-fix; `scopeNote` states this on every response. `candidates[].platform` reuses the AI-citation platform classification (YouTube/TikTok/Reddit/Wikipedia/LinkedIn/Quora, or null) at no extra cost.

brand.description: Brand name or bare domain to search for as a SERP QUERY (not a URL to fetch).

languageCode.description: Language code. Defaults to the project's stored market, else 'en'.

locationCode.description: Numeric location code. Defaults to the project's stored market, else 2840 (United States).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

trackedDomain.description: Bare domain each result page is checked for a link to, e.g. 'acme.com'.

name: get_unlinked_mentions_report
